review_scope: Technical comparison of 23 paired composed physical views after seating the authored boot scraper and vestibule stand. The placement, bearings, original input and clearance proof use separate receipts.

images.observation: Boiler face, piping and surrounding floor retain the same readable edges.
Bookcase edges and the adjacent prop and threshold read the same.
The cistern, wall joints and narrow corner retain coverage.
Both stations frame the same dark brick. This view gives limited direct evidence of the lift finish.
Floor grain, table, shelving and the companion remain in place.
Tile joints under the light and the screen remain legible despite a small framing shift.
The floor, resident, shelving and radiator remain seated in the room.
Floor, window, furniture and shelf surfaces match with a small camera shift.
Counter, steel sink and wall finishes retain coverage. Screen animation differs.
Open enclosure, controls and conduit are intact. The shadow and lid tone differ between frames.
Both low-light views retain the bar rail and the cat silhouette.
The sleeping cat and framed portrait hold the same dark bar lighting.
Cat, brackets and roof underside remain visible in both views.
The bank, surrounds and waiting bench retain match and readable outlines.
The radiator, wooden screen and nearby tabletop retain coverage.
Roof access floor, rail and services are visually consistent.
Tank panels and supports remain seated against the same rooftop silhouette.
Terminal casing and controls and their immediate surrounds retain finish.
Tile joints and the cistern remain continuous. Natural light differs between captures.
Residue remains visible on the floor and the surrounding geometry reads consistently.
The fixture and growth retain the same material boundaries. Growth animation differs.
Toaster, crumbs, kettle and counter surfaces remain visible.
Both dark captures show the wall-mounted watch station and wall plane. Fine contrast is limited.
